item.title: Oha
item.author: emecas
item.description:
oha
https://github.com/hatoo/oha
Ohayou(おはよう), HTTP load generator, inspired by rakyll/hey with tui animation.

oha is a tiny program that sends some load to a web application and show realtime tui inspired by rakyll/hey.

This program is written in Rust and powered by tokio and beautiful tui by ratatui.

Installation Process:

item.title: What is ANTLR?
item.author: emecas
item.description:
ANTLR
What is ANTLR?
“ANTLR (ANother Tool for Language Recognition) is a powerful parser generator for reading, processing, executing, or translating structured text or binary files. It’s widely used to build languages, tools, and frameworks. From a grammar, ANTLR generates a parser that can build and walk parse trees. From http://www.antlr.org

Source: commit 3850341 in My-Notes.
